36.29322,-78.57263: Central Orphanage Of North Carolina. Founded 1883. Pioneer Negro child-caring institution, serving on state-wide basis.
36.29898,-78.58226: Henry P. Cheatham 1857 1935. Born into slavery. U.S. Congressman, 1889-1893. Superintendent of Colored Orphanage of N.C., 1907-1935. Grave 8/10 mi. N.E.
